__meta: REUSABLE. ACS Call Automation operations from Log Analytics (ACSCallAutomationIncomingOperations). Table of operation volume + result split — the api-requests/operations archetype from the reference dashboard, retargeted at ACS diagnostic logs.
title: ACS — Call Automation operations
description: ACS Call Automation operation volume by operation and result, from Log Analytics diagnostic logs.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ACSCallAutomationIncomingOperations
| where TimeGenerated $__timeFilter()
| summarize Count = count() by OperationName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
